block.em: where am i in the world?

block: is a poetic narrative composed of reflections, dreams, and materials
gathered during our wedding journey to the island of Ærø, Denmark.
for sometimes many years of living in a country are as airy as a few.
the poem is best experienced on a laptop or desktop, in fullscreen mode.
it is not optimised for mobile.
it features audio, and headphones are recommended.
it lasts around 20 minutes, depending on the letter speed.
the letter speed can be adjusted by pressing the ▼ and ▲ keys on your keyboard.
a speed indicator bar should briefly appear at the bottom right corner of your screen.
progress is not saved and refreshing starts anew.
